scope: Independent geometric design argument, not rendered/native evidence.

collector_reference.schema: normalized target-local region; existing sampling fields only

assumptions: R19 and A-primary-fill-boundary establish 16-native-unit horizontal bands containing fill only, no primary border and a painted rectangle matching the native control rectangle.
R21/primary-width-upper assesses native control width <= 430 - 32 - 2*20 = 358 native units; primary-height assesses native control height >= 48.
R19 fixes circular corner radius 12, with no shadows/gradients/translucency under R17. Each action label remains inside its inner content rectangle.
argument: For any width <=358, every sampled x is <10.74<16, strictly inside the reserved side padding and outside the inner label content. For any height >=48, y=35%..65% stays at least 16.8 from top and bottom, beyond both 12-unit rounded corners. Thus the ROI lies in plain opaque fill, independent of font metrics. The contract still requires valid original mapping, visibility, pixel count and unambiguous support; failures remain U, never inferred pass.
unchanged_collector_policy: No collector/schema/tolerance changes; minimum_pixels=12, support=0.8 and channel_tolerance=2 are unchanged from v1.
